items.html: Now it has been explained that the fourth correction and the sixth correction are two aspects of Netzah and Hod: the ears, which are sealed in the secret of the two membranes, which is why only the aspect of the hairs that emerge from them is mentioned. And corresponding to this correction it says in Sifra deTzniuta, "They are clean wool, hanging in a balance." And the second aspect is the two eyes, and corresponding to them it says, "The open eye that does not sleep, and keeps watch continually" — which are the aspect of Netzah and Hod that are revealed, like the eyes that are revealed; and they are the aspect of the thighs, which are external and are not sealed, and they are below the Yesod hidden in the forehead, as was said.
